title: Corrected miscoded sex variable
summary: 3 records in the enrollment table had sex miscoded due to a REDCap branching logic error.
details: Affected records: 3 (participant IDs available in change log)
Field corrected: demo_sex
Root cause: REDCap branching logic skipped the field for records entered via mobile app between May 1–14
No downstream analyses used affected records prior to correction

title: Added caregiver burden questionnaire data
summary: New variables from the Zarit Burden Interview, collected at 12-month follow-up.
details: New file: caregiver_burden.csv
22 new variables (zbi_1 through zbi_22, plus zbi_total)
Coverage: 84 of 112 eligible participants
Codebook updated with domain label 'Caregiver Burden'

title: Updated data dictionary for cognitive battery
summary: Clarified scoring conventions for reverse-coded items in the cognitive battery.
details: Added scoring notes for cog_flex_3, cog_flex_7, cog_flex_9
No changes to underlying data values
Codebook PDF and interactive browser both updated

title: Freeze 6 released
summary: Sixth data freeze. Includes enrollment through May 31, 2026, plus first release of actigraphy summary variables.
details: N = 312 enrolled, 268 with complete baseline visits
New domain: actigraphy summary (sleep efficiency, total sleep time, wake bouts)
Enrollment data current through May 31, 2026
Withdrawal status updated for 6 participants since Freeze 5
File: cohort_freeze6.csv, actigraphy_summary_freeze6.csv

title: Removed duplicate MoCA records
summary: 8 duplicate MoCA administrations removed after data manager audit.
details: Cause: double data entry during site transition in April
Retained record: earliest complete administration per participant
Removed records logged separately for audit trail

title: Added race/ethnicity detail variables
summary: Expanded single race/ethnicity field into granular multi-select variables per NIH reporting requirements.
details: New variables: race_white, race_black, race_asian, race_aian, race_nhpi, race_other, ethnicity_hispanic
Original combined field (race_ethnicity) retained for backward compatibility
Backfilled from source consent forms where available (94% coverage)

title: Corrected age calculation error
summary: Age at enrollment was calculated from visit date instead of consent date for 14 records.
details: Affected variable: age_enroll
Discrepancy ranged from 1 to 34 days
Corrected using consent_date field as source of truth going forward
